Hi Olivia - thanks for the quick response. Answering your questions inline below and adding a couple of concrete options so procurement can evaluate: 

- Retention windows: Redwood supports configurable retention per-collection/route. Defaults: logs (30 days), request/response artifacts (90 days). We can configure longer retention (up to 7 years) for enterprise contracts; per-route overrides are supported as part of the Dedicated/Private offering.

- SOC 2: attaching SOC2_summary.pdf that includes contact for our security team (security@redwood.com). We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under NDA or a time-boxed evidence package - procurement preference?

- PHI handling: two options:
  1) Hosted with PHI controls: encryption at rest (AES-256), encryption in transit (TLS1.3), strict RBAC, audit logs exported to customer-owned S3 (or equivalent). PHI flagged records can be marked and subject to different retention.
  2) Private deployment: VPC/on-premises deployment where PHI never traverses Redwood-hosted multi-tenant systems. We can provide a deployment runbook and KMS integration notes.

- De-identification: We do not offer an automatic PHI scrub by default; many customers run a pre-ingest de-id step. We can connect on options and partner recommendations for de-identification pipelines.

I've attached the SOC2 summary and the editable DPA draft for your legal team to review. Per the MAP, I'll circulate an updated milestone table by EOD with explicit owners and dates.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Jacob / Olivia - following up with concrete answers and an updated MAP milestone table (see attachments).

Answers to procurement questions:
1) Audit logs: Default retention in hosted mode is 90 days; enterprise customers can configure retention up to 7 years. Audit logs can be exported daily to customer-owned S3 in JSONL format (compressed). We also support push to SIEM via HTTPS webhook (JSON).
2) KMS: Yes - we support BYOK via AWS KMS CMKs and HSM integrations for private deployments. We'll include a KMS integration checklist in the runbook.
3) Point of contact: security@redwood.com (primary), with a named lead: Rishi Malhotra. Typical evidence turnaround for redacted SOC2 artifacts under NDA is 3-5 business days; full evidence packages may take longer depending on scope.

- Dependencies: MedTel legal sign-off on DPA, completion of SOC2 evidence exchange, and decision on deployment mode (Hosted w/ controls vs Private VPC).

Next steps (agreed):

If that timeline looks good we'll aim to close the milestone by 2026-03-31. If procurement needs an accelerated timeline, we can prioritize SOC2 evidence under NDA.

Thanks everyone - feel free to reply with redlines or set a 30-min call if you'd prefer to walk through the MAP live.
